messages:
maria: Quick sync — pen test update. Assessors asked to include the feature-flagged KV cache service in staging. Need to confirm three things before we open the window: (1) ephemeral RBAC window length (propose min 2h), (2) KMS delegation approach for snapshot export, (3) audit-log preservation + evidence upload path. Proposed staging window: 2024-03-21 16:00–18:00 UTC. Can ops/security weigh in?

 tim: +1 on 2h window. For KMS: export job will need kms:Decrypt (or kms:GenerateDataKey if we do envelope). Question — provision a dedicated export key for assessors or reuse staging key? Reuse risks audit mixing.

 sasha: Recommend dedicated export key scoped to assessor principal. Limit actions to ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"] and add key policy condition to only allow from the ephemeral role ARN. Also route exported artifacts to a separate evidence-bucket with 90d retention. Presigned URLs for upload sounds best.

 andre: Ops note: we can offer an STS-based ephemeral IAM role (AssumeRole) for the assessors. Session duration up to 2h is fine. We need the exact assessor ARNs (or their OIDC-subjects) to bake into the trust policy. Also need to whitelist outbound egress from staging so they can upload to evidence-bucket.

 zoe: Audit logging: enable object-level access logs + CloudTrail for KMS events and S3 object-level events. We'll export to SIEM and snapshot a copy into the evidence-bucket at t+30m. Also enforce write-once prefixes (date/assessor-id/) to avoid tampering. Redaction checklist: PII must be removed client-side before upload unless assessor explicitly documents why it's required.

 maria: Action items: Sasha to post a KMS policy snippet we can review; Andre to schedule the role bake and publish the ephemeral role ARN + presigned URL instructions; Ops to confirm network egress. Can we nominate a retest verifier? @tim?

 tim: I can own the retest verification. After remediation we should: (a) reproduce the exploit on the canary, (b) collect logs and hashes, (c) run smoke tests, (d) tag artifacts 'pt-retest-<date>' and attach to the ticket. Also list remediation PRs in the ticket.

 ops-bot: deploy scheduled: create-ephemeral-role staging-pt-window 1707657600-1707658800

 sasha: KMS policy draft for review:
```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/assessor-role"},
      "Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource":"*"
    }
  ]
}
```
Limit to key usage by adding a Condition that checks aws:SourceArn or aws:RequestTag later if needed.

 andre: Uploaded presigned URL guide -> https://internal/docs/pt/evidence-presigned.ops. Will create the ephemeral role tomorrow at 15:30 PT and paste the role ARN here once done. Also will validate S3 bucket policy to only accept uploads from that role and the CI account.

 zoe: Evidence naming policy: include 'pt-ticket-#1234' and assessor id in filename; generate sha256 checksums, store checksums in a checksum-manifest at upload time. We'll snapshot audit logs 30 minutes after window opens and archive to gs://redwood-pt-archive/ with retention 90d.

 maria: Confirm tentative retest window: 2024-03-22 18:00–20:00 UTC. If everyone OK I'll open JIRA PT-1234 and assign tasks.

 tim: Approved from my side. Add the list of remediation PRs and verification steps.

 maria: Awesome — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
